body: The calibration. At 0 the verify is the real one; at 1 every byte must be reported bad and the ladder must stop at BLUE. An oracle that cannot report bad is not evidence (L-FALSIF).

author: val
body: The fill is chunked so it can report. 2.7 MB poked one byte at a time is minutes on the medium's own timescale and the ladder said nothing during it, which is half of why the flight was unreadable. The bar is BLUE because blue is the rung this stage is working toward: a bar advancing under an orange field is progress toward `wrote`, and a bar frozen part way is where it died. A chunk boundary rather than a modulo test per byte keeps the cost off the inner loop.
